subject: Quarterly top-up acceleration & alignment to annual renewal
messages:
From: Sarah Coleman <sarah@averylabs.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@averylabs.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quarterly top-up acceleration & alignment to annual renewal

Neha —

Quick note from our side: we hit a larger-than-expected spike this month and need to accelerate a 40% top-up on our committed capacity now, rather than waiting until the planned November uplift. Our renewal is scheduled for 2026-11-10 and wed like to co-term the top-up to the existing renewal date if possible.

Primary asks:
- Can Redwood apply any short-window acceleration discount to the top-up to reflect the mid-cycle nature?
- Can we co-term the top-up to our November renewal and have the uplift amortized over the remaining 3 months?
- Our procurement team needs a short quote and an editable amendment to kick off PO today.

I attached the draft PO the internal finance team prepared.

Thanks —
Sarah Coleman
Head of ML Platform, Avery Labs
Avery Labs | sarah@averylabs.com
Attachment: Avery_PO_2026-08-04.pdf (application/pdf, 42KB)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Coleman <sarah@averylabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarterly top-up acceleration & alignment to annual renewal

Sarah — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO. Were seeing the same pattern in usage on our end (prefix cache less effective for this batch) so the request makes sense.

Short answers up front:
1) Acceleration discount: we can offer a limited 6% mid-cycle uplift discount for top-ups executed within a 10-day window. This is intended to offset short-term procurement friction while preserving the renewal economics.
2) Co-terming: yes — we can co-term the added capacity to your 2026-11-10 renewal. The mechanics would be: the top-up is effective immediately, billed pro rata now, then the remainder amortized across the final 3 months to align to the renewal date.
3) Quote & amendment: Ill send an editable amendment/quote by EOD that procurement can attach to the PO.

Ben / Jordan: can you confirm the margin/discount approval on a 40% top-up with a 6% concession and flag any constraints on SLA or capacity scheduling? If ok, Ill prepare the amendment and DocuSign path.

Next step: Sarah, if procurement can confirm the PO ID and preferred billing contact, Ill prioritize the quote.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Sarah Coleman <sarah@averylabs.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarterly top-up acceleration & alignment to annual renewal

Neha / Sarah — put it on my radar. A couple of notes from pricing ops:
- 6% concession on a one-time 40% top-up is within the delegated approval band for AE-level requests, provided we dont extend the same rate to any other concurrent deals.
- We need to ensure the co-term amortization doesnt distort the unit economics for the committed period; Jordan, please ensure billing can emit a prorated invoice now and a final equalization invoice on co-term date.
- No SLA change required; just confirm capacity reservation for the top-up in the us-west pool for one month, then it will be rolled into the annual commit.

Approve on principle. Neha, you can proceed to generate the amendment. Ill stand by for the final quote.

- Ben
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Procurement Team <procurement@averylabs.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarterly top-up acceleration & alignment to annual renewal

Neha / Ben —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. PO attached (same as Sarah sent) and PO ID is AV-PO-7781. Billing contact is: Finance AP <ap@averylabs.com>. We need an editable amendment (Word or Google Doc) and the total invoice amount for the initial pro rata charge so we can process the PO today.

Also, can you call out whether the 6% concession is applied to the incremental top-up only or to the blended existing commit + top-up? Procurement prefers it be limited to the incremental top-up line item.

Procurement Team
Avery Labs
Attachment: Avery_PO_2026-08-04.pdf (application/pdf, 42KB)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@averylabs.com>, Sarah Coleman <sarah@averylabs.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarterly top-up acceleration & alignment to annual renewal

Hi all —

Attached is the editable amendment (Word) and the quote with line-level pricing. Key callouts:
- 6% concession applied only to the incremental top-up line (40% of current commit), per procurement request.
- Initial pro rata invoice = $45,600 (covers effective period through 2026-08-31).
- Remaining amortized amount will be split across Sep and Oct invoices so the contract aligns with the 2026-11-10 renewal.
- Weve reserved the extra capacity in the us-west pool for one month; we will automatically fold the capacity into the annual commit on renewal.

Attachments: Redwood_Amendment_quote_AV-8943.pdf (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 18KB)

Next steps: Procurement to confirm PO AV-PO-7781 is approved and return signed PO or confirmation email; Neha will kick DocuSign once we have confirmation.

Jordan Blake
Renewals & Expansion, Redwood Inference
